local_vs_repository: A local commit affects that store only. Repository publication needs exact registry/index/projection/drift/state postimages and the applicable authority route.
read_compatibility: Read existing Definition/v1 and selected Definition/v2 through exact declared carriers. No bulk conversion or alias.
revision_policy: Exact predecessor and new immutable revision; native revise/withdraw and dependent-type checks remain the owner.
source_transition_policy: Explicit source successor plus compatible consumers/profiles/store selection; never silently rebase or reuse old signatures.
